boundary: Handoff package only. MC-15 is not started, no website page or metadata is modified, and no public content is authorised by this file.

navigational aid (not a certified navigation system)
EMBARCARTE as company name (subject to legal identity completion)
forbiddenPublicVocabulary: MAREA as a public brand until trademark clearance and a public-use decision exist
available, in stock, buy, order, delivery date, price from
CE marked, certified, approved, homologated, wheelmark

brandPublicationRestrictions.headerFooterBrandUsage: No MAREA public lock-up, wordmark or ® / ™ until clearance; EMBARCARTE attribution only if the legal identity is complete.
brandPublicationRestrictions.ogImagesAndSocial: No MAREA-named social previews until public-use clearance.
brandPublicationRestrictions.investorOrPartnerDecks: Same restrictions apply; internal-only labels must be visible.
brandPublicationRestrictions.conflictRule: The stricter MC-14 gate prevails over MC-03 class-A allowances; a formal supersession decision is required before any change.

publicClaimsGates.rule: A claim classified A for internal documentation is not authorised for public publication. Every public claim requires an evidence record, approver sign-off and an open release gate.
publicClaimsGates.bilingualRule: ES and EN must carry the same class, status, risk links and numbers; semantic drift is treated as a prohibited claim.

legalFooterRequirements: Verified registered company name, tax ID, address and registry data (currently empty in SITE.legal).
Legal notice, terms of use, privacy policy and cookie policy links.
No MAREA public brand attribution until clearance.
VAT and price-display basis if any price is ever shown.
No 'certified', 'official' or 'approved' badge in the footer.

ctaAllowed: register interest only where a lawful mechanism exists
productAndBundlePageRestrictions.pilot: Never purchasable; supervised-only boundary and safety gate must be stated wherever PILOT is mentioned.
productAndBundlePageRestrictions.ais: Receive-only; no transmission, transponder, collision-avoidance or DSC implication.
productAndBundlePageRestrictions.watch: No guaranteed alert delivery or continuous offshore coverage; disclaimers required.
productAndBundlePageRestrictions.fleet: B2B only; no default hardware; no SLA until measured and contracted.
productAndBundlePageRestrictions.weather: Probabilistic forecasts; source and freshness required; no accuracy or official status.
productAndBundlePageRestrictions.nav: Navigational aid only; no official chart, ECDIS or navigation-grade claim.
productAndBundlePageRestrictions.bundles: No bundle may be presented as purchasable while any included product is not available; PILOT-containing bundles cannot be sold.

privacyCookieRequirements: Cookie inventory and prior consent before non-essential cookies.
Cookie policy ES/EN consistent with the consent mechanism.
Privacy notice naming controller, purposes, legal bases, recipients, retention and rights.
Google Identity Services and payment provider recipients disclosed.
Registration/consent evidence stored server-side where consent is presented.
commerceCtaRestrictions: Checkout must not be exposed for MAREA products while NOT_FOR_SALE.
Existing sample commerce must be disabled or clearly separated from MAREA before any publication.
Server-authoritative price/stock rules remain; no client-side price or stock override.
No card data stored; hosted/tokenised provider only, and only after a merchant agreement.
Refund, withdrawal and complaint information must be reachable before the order.
structuredDataRestrictions: No Product/Offer JSON-LD for MAREA until availability, approved price and seller identity exist.
No aggregateRating, review or customer-count markup without real evidence.
Brand field must not assert registered trademark status.
Locale and currency must match the approved display rules.
Existing structured data in the site must be inventoried and remediated under MC-15.
seoMetadataRestrictions: No MAREA in titles/descriptions until public-use clearance.
No availability, price, certification or performance in meta descriptions.
Canonical/hreflang reciprocity must be preserved for existing indexed URLs.
No duplicate ES/EN implementation; typed localized routes remain the architecture.
Structured data and sitemap changes require the MC-15 release gate.

pageByPageIssues.summary: Shop/SEO instructs buying unavailable Open Marine Hub/autopilot; availability and product identity issues.
Ownership/open-source claims and autopilot safety claims.
Missing legal identity; incomplete privacy recipients; non-binding draft notice.
Incomplete controller/recipient information and unrecorded registration consent.
GIS cookie disclosure and consent mechanism gaps.
Checkout CTAs, VAT-included labelling, shipping costs after order.
Autopilot and test/safety claims in About/home content.
Product/Offer JSON-LD with admin price/stock and Open Marine brand; compatibility claims.

esEnConsistencyRequirements: One component per page; no duplicated ES/EN implementations.
Dictionary parity and localized route parity must be preserved.
Claims must be paired and semantically consistent; no translation may soften or strengthen a claim.
Legal, privacy and cookie pages must carry equivalent disclosures in both languages.
requiredEvidenceBeforeAvailabilityOrPric: Approved price list with VAT basis and territory.
OPERATIONS READY lifecycle decision and real stock/fulfilment record.
Signed consumer/B2B terms and legal identity.
Approved claim record with evidence and approver.
Open and verified release gates: GATE-PRICING, GATE-LEGAL-ENTITY, GATE-CONSUMER-TERMS, GATE-PAYMENTS, GATE-COMMERCIAL-CLAIMS.
Commerce decision for the existing sample shop.
doNotDo: Do not modify website pages, routes, metadata, prices, checkout or deployment in MC-14.
Do not publish MAREA as a brand or product availability.
Do not translate claims without the bilingual parity check.
Do not add Product/Offer structured data before approval.
Do not treat this handoff as MC-15 execution.
